name: Teardown
thesis: Pull the car apart. Everything that comes off is for sale.

pages.index.html: landing: scroll-driven disassembly stage with projected price tags, teardowns in progress, real 3D wheel viewer, start-a-teardown form, reserve drawer

showpiece: A 420vh sticky stage: scrolling pulls eight photographic part cutouts out of a Supra one by one along their own vectors, HTML price tags are projected from 3D each frame, and the last stretch of scroll knolls everything into a laid-out grid. Hover raycasts to a part; click opens the listing. Plus a real GLB wheel mesh (image-to-3D) you can drag to turn.
